tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App ground behind panels. Never put body text directly on it in dense areas; use `panel`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels: chat, editor chrome, timeline, settings, header.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and the variant picker. Pair with `shadow-pop`.

tokens.name: inset
tokens.usage: Wells: the code editor, text and number inputs, the console.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: 3D viewer background only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and list rows. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, switch track). At least 3:1 on `panel` and `inset` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `panel`, `panel-raised`, `inset` and every `*-soft` ground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, timestamps, token counts, placeholder hints. 4.5:1 or better on `bg`, `panel` and `inset`.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons only. Exempt from contrast; never use for readable content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Layout blue, after the machinist's marking dye: primary buttons, links, the active selection, the picked part. Text-safe on `bg` and `panel`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill. Never plain white in dark theme.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active tab ground, the scoped-part chip. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the surface colour. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: filament
tokens.usage: The model itself in the viewer, and the brand mark. Fills only: it fails as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: pick
tokens.usage: Highlight of the tapped part in the 3D view and its source range in the editor.

tokens.name: part-1
tokens.usage: Part colour 1 (orange). Part colours label top-level parts in review frames and the viewer's Part colours mode; they are labels, never the design. Okabe–Ito based so they stay apart for colour-blind users.

tokens.name: part-2
tokens.usage: Part colour 2 (sky blue).

tokens.name: part-3
tokens.usage: Part colour 3 (green).

tokens.name: part-4
tokens.usage: Part colour 4 (yellow).

tokens.name: part-5
tokens.usage: Part colour 5 (blue).

tokens.name: part-6
tokens.usage: Part colour 6 (vermillion).

tokens.name: part-7
tokens.usage: Part colour 7 (pink). An eighth part reuses part-1, and the legend says so.

tokens.name: part-none
tokens.usage: Faces not matched to a part (inside hull or minkowski).

tokens.name: frame-ground
tokens.usage: Ground of review frames. Fixed in both themes, so the reviewer model always gets the same image.

tokens.name: sheet-paper
tokens.usage: Paper of the dimensioned drawing export. Fixed in both themes, so the sheet prints the same.

tokens.name: sheet-ink
tokens.usage: Lines, dimensions, labels and scale bar on the drawing export. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: sheet-muted
tokens.usage: Caption text on the drawing export. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Compiled / success text and icons. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success banners and console lines. `ok` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: OpenSCAD WARNING lines, CORS hints, approaching limits.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning banners and console lines. `warn` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failed renders, ERROR lines, timeouts, destructive actions. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners, console lines and the editor's error line. `error` and `ink` read on it.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Viewer grid, 1 mm cells.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Viewer grid, 10 mm sections.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis line and gizmo label. Axis colours follow the RGB = XYZ convention; never use them for status.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis line and gizmo label.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis (up) line and gizmo label.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Editor: module, function, for, if, let, include, use.

tokens.name: syn-builtin
tokens.usage: Editor: built-in modules and functions (cube, translate, difference).

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Editor: numbers, and Customizer ranges in comments.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Editor: strings.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Editor: comments. 4.5:1 on `inset`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the first-run screen only. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles, project name in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Make the hole 2 mm wider and add a chamfer to the lid.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: List item titles, button labels, parameter names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and Customizer group tabs. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under messages, versions and variants.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The code editor and inline code in chat.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Dimensions, parameter values, render times. Use tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in lists, console and timeline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; phone side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between groups; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and first-run spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, console highlights, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, message bubbles, version rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets, variant cards, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the switch track only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: `panel-raised` surfaces that float: menus, popovers, dialogs. Panels themselves use `line` borders, never shadows.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact toolbar buttons and inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control on touch devices, sliders included.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header and the phone tab bar.
